### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Accurately link medications to their stated conditions. Do not infer a condition is "well-controlled" if patient's description indicates ongoing severity or lack of control.
[O]: Report only explicitly stated physical exam findings. Do not infer comprehensive system assessments or the absence of abnormalities if only partial findings are mentioned, especially if patient-reported symptoms contradict such inferences.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[A]: Limit diagnostic assessments and etiological connections to those explicitly stated or confirmed by the provider. Do not infer potential relationships between symptoms and conditions or propose differential diagnoses not discussed.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[O]: Report only explicitly stated physical exam findings and *only for examinations explicitly mentioned as performed*. Do not infer comprehensive system assessments or the absence of abnormalities if only partial findings are mentioned, especially if patient-reported symptoms contradict such inferences.
